episode_title: S1E25 | Accelerating Growth: Personal Brand, Tech Innovation & Outsourcing | Belinda Agnew

real_qa.q: What is Accelerator's subscription-based model for developers and product building?
real_qa.r: Accelerator offers a subscription-based model where companies can tap into access to developers to build products starting from four thousand a month. The company operates two sides: internal staff who come into companies to grow, scale, and build, and contractors accessible through subscription where businesses can build without necessarily having the budget to do so independently.

real_qa.q: How has Belinda Agnew shifted her approach from sales-first to marketing-first business strategy?
real_qa.r: Belinda initially built her first two businesses with a sales-first approach, but has since shifted to marketing-first after surrounding herself with smart people and recognizing that to scale and go big, marketing must come before sales. She now focuses on one-to-millions leverage rather than one-to-one selling, stating that if you are not talking about what you are selling, no one will know what you are selling.
real_qa.requete: Belinda Agnew marketing before sales strategy

real_qa.q: Why does personal branding matter more than business branding for entrepreneurs building multiple ventures?
real_qa.r: Personal branding allows entrepreneurs to build a community following their journey across multiple projects, whereas a business brand stays tied to a single company. When you build a personal brand, customers feel invested in your journey and will support whatever you do next, whereas business relationships are often tied to individual salespeople who leave after typically two years, making the business brand unstackable.
real_qa.requete: personal brand vs business brand entrepreneurs

real_qa.q: What is Accelerator formerly known as and how did the company rebrand?
real_qa.r: Accelerator was originally called ExEnabler, but the company completely changed its name and branding to reflect its broader mission. The new name Accelerator better represents what they do: accelerating brands, accelerating product, and accelerating and scaling companies, rather than just building products.

real_qa.q: What is Amelia Sordell's personal branding agency and how has her LinkedIn following grown?
real_qa.r: Amelia Sordell runs a successful personal branding agency in London called Clout. She has grown her LinkedIn following from ten thousand to one hundred fifty thousand followers and is described as having nailed every angle when it comes to personal branding.
real_qa.requete: Amelia Sordell Clout personal branding agency

real_qa.q: What is the average tenure of salespeople compared to their peak performance timeline?
real_qa.r: A recent statistic shows that the average salesperson reaches peak performance after two and a half years in their role, but the average salesperson stays for only eighteen months, meaning most salespeople leave before reaching their peak effectiveness.
real_qa.requete: average salesperson tenure peak performance 2.5 years 18 months

guest.bio_context: Belinda started her entrepreneurial journey at 18, founding an RTO called AIPE and a marketing sales agency called Open Education for educational institutions. She then built a recruitment agency focused on talent acquisition for corporates before transitioning into the tech space. After joining advisory boards to understand tech business fundamentals, she became CMO of a tech company and recently bought into it as a 50-50 partner, helping scale the business which now operates with 120 internal developers and access to 1,100 contractors.
